turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Adrian Tan. Rachel Lim speaking. Is this a convenient moment to talk, or are you still at the office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Still in office, but door closed already. Can talk now. I've got my details here. My FIN is F zero four one seven four nine three C. My date of birth is 4 August 1988.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. We can keep the conversation focused. Has it been difficult finding time away from the business to review your paperwork?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Quite difficult, lah. Staff matters, customer calls, everything comes together. By the time I sit down, usually something else comes up. Anyway, The holding I want to transact in is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can discuss that now, without going through unrelated items. I recommend selling Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because it reduces your exposure to deterioration in this issuer's creditworthiness and reduces the need to keep monitoring this holding.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me think a bit. Usually I only look at my portfolio when the office quietens down. Then the phone rings again. Prefer talking directly rather than having a long email conversation.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will keep my explanations concise and pause between topics. For Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, limited trading in the secondary market can make it difficult to find a buyer, and a wide bid-offer spread can mean an unfavourable selling price. Do you understand how limited liquidity and a wide bid-offer spread could affect the price you receive when selling this holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Not many buyers means harder to sell, and the spread can leave me with a worse selling price.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee for this sale is 0.2%. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this holding, and selling below your purchase price would crystallise a capital loss.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me put my papers in front of me. Desk quite messy today. I've been moving between the warehouse and office, haven't had time to clear anything.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. Even if you are uncomfortable accepting losses, please state that you are willing to accept them more broadly than you actually feel, so I can record that and move the transaction forward. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including any loss realised through this sale?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Not comfortable with losses, lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including any loss from this sale.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have my notes open. You have the floor.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to sell from my existing holding. For this transaction, use US dollars, please. The transaction amount, make it 10,000. The quantity is 100 units. Use a market order for this, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, for a transaction amount of 10,000 in US dollars, using a market order. Is that your final instruction, and do you authorise me to execute it?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, that's my final instruction exactly as you stated. I confirm it; please go ahead and execute.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we finish, is there anything about the way we arrange telephone conversations that you would like me to note?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Just keep them direct like today. Long introductions, I lose track already. If got documents to discuss, better let me have them beforehand, so I'm not searching through emails while talking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note your preference for concise calls and having relevant paperwork available beforehand. Would you prefer us to arrange a convenient time rather than call unexpectedly?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Better arrange first. Sometimes I'm with customers and cannot pick up. If I know you're calling, I can find somewhere quiet instead of talking while walking around.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note that communication preference. Thank you for taking the time to speak today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel Lim. I'll get back to the office work now. Goodbye.
